candidates.claim: OT-facing port GigabitEthernet1/0/7 on sw-ot-01 is an access port in VLAN 30 instead of VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Set GigabitEthernet1/0/7 on sw-ot-01 back to access VLAN 10 and confirm no CORP device is attached to it.

candidates.claim: Trunk GigabitEthernet1/0/22 on sw-core-01 allows VLAN 30 in addition to its approved set {10,99}, so CORP and OT VLANs share one trunk.
candidates.remediation: Remove VLAN 30 from the allowed VLAN list of GigabitEthernet1/0/22 on sw-core-01.

candidates.claim: Baseline delta: allowed VLANs on sw-core-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/22 changed from {10,99} to {10,30,99}.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change against the approved baseline and revert it unless an approved change record exists.

candidates.claim: Baseline delta: access VLAN of sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/7 changed from 10 to 30.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile this change against the approved baseline and restore access VLAN 10 unless an approved change record exists.

candidates.claim: Baseline delta: shutdown added on sw-ot-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/12, which is in the authorized Unit 2 outage list.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile against the Unit 2 outage record and remove the shutdown when the outage window ends.
